title: My first Game on itch.io! It's Just Logic
author: Cautious-Western1298
selftext:
Hi, this game is made from an idea by me a couple years ago, and I am finally done turning it into a playable game! I guess it might look like battleship from a first glance, but the gameplay is much different, so check it out ig, its free and i want some feedbacks! I kinda like this very simple UI, its just simple graphics and deep gameplay. What makes it really fun and unique is the mix of luck and logic. You are not just mindlessly guessing, but you are also not stuck doing endless brain calculations every turn. So yeah check it out and give me some feedbacks!

The game have code made by Claude Code, art and sound by me. 

: ）

[https://drpineapp1e.itch.io/its-just-logic](https://drpineapp1e.itch.io/its-just-logic)

comments.author: TurnYourBrightsOFF
comments.body:
This is just my first 15-minute impression, so my opinion could change over time, but it took me awhile to figure out how to play and I almost quit during the process, even after reading the guide. I did not find the UI intuitive. You mention that the fun comes from making endless brain calculations every turn, but I was not really sure what strategic decisions I was supposed to be making. During the tutorial, I was supposed to click on a moving tile, but the instructions disappeared before I even had time to read them and it just said "Oh well!"

I consider myself a strategic thinker and usually enjoy strategy games. I'm happy to test future iterations and answer questions if you ever want feedback sometime. I'm not here to bash your game because I see early development potential in it, but in its current state it just was not fun for me personally.

replies.author: Cautious-Western1298
replies.body: thank you for the detailed comment! (btw i said "but you are also NOT stuck doing endless brain calculations every turn." you might have read the thing wrong). This is just the basic form and idea of the game. It will be super helpful if you can give me comments on how the game is fun/not fun and how it can be better. thanks a lot! :D

replies.author: TurnYourBrightsOFF
replies.body: I did read your message completely wrong I apologize; I must be really tired.  It is definitely something I think I'd want to play if it was polished that is why I replied... It has a lot of potential.  I will keep checking on itch site if that is where you update it.  I'll write down my thoughts in real-time next time as I'm playing it.  I do remember wishing that there was a tooltip system I could just put my mouse over.  And I didn't know I had to switch to enemy grid to make my turn (maybe that could be more obvious).
